newsitem.title: INDIA: Motorola, Punwire in India firm.
newsitem.headline: Motorola, Punwire in India firm.

text.p: Motorola Inc and India's Punjab Wireless Ltd (Punwire) said on Saturday they launched a joint venture to offer radio trunking services in 15 northern Indian cities including the capital city of Delhi.

ProCall Private Ltd, in which Motorola will hold 49 percent and Punwire 51 percent, would start operations after getting final approval from India's Department of Telecommunications (DoT), which is expected shortly, the statement said.
Mobile radio trunking allows simultaneous communication between members of a group, sub-group or on one-to-one basis at the push of a button, the statement added.

ProCall has been licenced by DoT to operate in Delhi, Gurgaon, Ghaziabad, Faridabad, Panipat, Chandigarh, Jaipur, Lucknow, Kanpur, Jammu and Amritsar, Jalandhar, Ludhiana, Allahabad and Varanasi (Benares), the statement added.

"We would like to position ProCall as India's professional mobile hotline and we expect to have a subscriber base of 45,000 in 15 cities within a period of five years," said Gurpal Singh, Punwire's chairman.
Motorola Inc is a world leader in wireless communications.
Punwire supplies wireless communication equipment to the Indian government, defence forces, police and paramilitary forces, the statement said.
